mechanism_description: Dev-only BTC ETF-flow data plumbing layer with strict U.S. trading-session semantics and causal alignment to BTC UTC daily usage.

selected_primary_source.why: Preferred paid provider. Provides historical aggregate BTC ETF flow plus per-ETF ticker breakdown in one machine-readable endpoint.

dev_only_fallback_primary_source.why: Free public HTML-table fallback with daily per-ETF USD flows and aggregate total flow, acceptable only for non-authoritative dev-only research with strict parser validation.

optional_secondary_source.why: Provides aggregate-only enrichment for cumulative net inflow, total net assets, and total value traded.

causal_alignment_rule.us_trading_session_date: Provider session date for the U.S. ETF trading day.
causal_alignment_rule.date: BTC UTC day when the prior U.S. trading-session ETF flow first becomes causally usable.
causal_alignment_rule.btc_spot_join_rule: btc_spot_close is joined on us_trading_session_date only.
causal_alignment_rule.weekend_holiday_policy: No synthetic weekend or U.S. holiday rows are emitted. Rolling flow features run across the last three U.S. trading sessions only.
